{{Top|leg}}
'''Dykara''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Dykara commented on the entry for the [[B22 Hold-Out Blaster|Model B22 hold-out blaster pistol]], noting it was deadly in the right hands despite its dainty appearance. Dykara once managed to convince a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that they were being fired on by two people at once by using an [[E-11/S blaster rifle]]. During a smuggling run to [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]], Dykara had the opportunity to witness [[Kaori Batta]] demonstrate the [[EXP-7(a) Predator]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
